title: Unit: save, resume and submit a training checklist
summary: Choose a published unit-target checklist, record three explicitly simulated answers, save progress, review the resumed answer, submit and verify the same-tab readback.
prerequisites: Authorized Unit access, Engine 51 selected and the published Engine 51 daily readiness training form available. No administrator setup is demonstrated.
Use a disposable fictional exercise. Engine 51 is selected with Released, No Active Call and one of one roles visible; the existing Herrmann crew assignment remains unchanged.
All three Pass selections are software-exercise answers. They do not certify physical inspection, stock condition or operational readiness.
The recorded location field remains blank. No failure/maintenance trigger, N/A branch, witness, signature, GPS, offline, browser-restart or cross-device outcome is demonstrated.

scenes.title: Choose the intended form and unit
scenes.capture_intent: Use the unmodified reviewed actual Unit screenshots in the candidate sequence. No operation or media timing is assigned.
scenes.narration: Open Checklists with Engine 51 selected. The left panel shows one of one roles, Released and No Active Call. Under Start checklist, find Engine 51 daily readiness, then choose the Engine 51 target directly beneath it. The Ambulance 61 template also offers an Engine 51 button, so check the form name before starting. This published training form is already available.
scenes.practice: Match both the published form name and target unit before starting an authorized training run.

scenes.title: Record an explicit exercise answer
scenes.capture_intent: Use the unmodified reviewed actual Unit screenshots in the candidate sequence. No operation or media timing is assigned.
required_labels: TRAINING ONLY - Software walkthrough answer; no physical equipment inspection was performed.
scenes.narration: The form identifies Engine 51 and Version 1. The first of three items is Equipment ready for the exercise, marked Required and Critical. For this software exercise, select Pass. Add a Note stating that this is a software walkthrough answer and no physical equipment inspection was performed. Read the answer and note together, then choose Next. The recorded Pass is a simulated exercise answer.
scenes.practice: For a disposable exercise, enter Pass with an explicit software-only note; do not substitute this for an inspection.

scenes.title: Keep the stock answer and note together
scenes.capture_intent: Use the unmodified reviewed actual Unit screenshots in the candidate sequence. No operation or media timing is assigned.
required_labels: TRAINING ONLY - Software exercise; no actual stock audit performed.
scenes.narration: Next opens Stock and supplies recorded, item two of three. Select Pass for the simulation and add a note that no actual stock audit was performed. The item note explains the meaning of this answer to a later reader. Review the item name, selected answer and note before choosing Next. Use the same review habit for a SAR cache or security patrol kit.
scenes.practice: Use an appropriate team checklist to review a hypothetical SAR cache or patrol kit; keep its item note specific.

scenes.title: Document scope and save progress
scenes.capture_intent: Use the unmodified reviewed actual Unit screenshots in the candidate sequence. No operation or media timing is assigned.
required_labels: TRAINING ONLY - Fictional exercise handover notes reviewed in the software.
TRAINING ONLY - Academy software demonstration. These simulated answers do not certify operational readiness or an actual equipment inspection.
scenes.narration: Item three is Handover notes reviewed. Select Pass and add the fictional handover note. Below the item controls, the general note states that these simulated answers do not certify operational readiness or an actual equipment inspection. In this example, location stays blank. Choose Save progress to retain the work before submission. For practice, keep the item note separate from the whole-run note.
scenes.practice: Distinguish the per-item handover note from the whole-run note and save the clearly labeled exercise.

scenes.title: Find the saved run
scenes.capture_intent: Use the unmodified reviewed actual Unit screenshots in the candidate sequence. No operation or media timing is assigned.
scenes.narration: Back on Checklists, Local drafts shows Draft 1. History also contains a timestamped Engine 51 run. Choose History and inspect that saved entry. The target name and time help distinguish it from another exercise. A history entry alone does not establish submission. For a community care vehicle, check the correct target just as carefully before reopening saved work.
scenes.practice: Find the intended saved exercise by target and timestamp; do not infer a submitted result from the list alone.

scenes.capture_intent: Use the unmodified reviewed actual Unit screenshots in the candidate sequence. No operation or media timing is assigned.

scenes.narration: Reopened in the same tab, the first item still shows Pass, its equipment note and the general software-only note. Review those values before continuing. We are looking at the first answer; the other items are not expanded together here. Save progress and Submit checklist are still available. For practice, reopen a saved exercise and compare its first answer and run note with what you saved.
scenes.practice: Reopen saved work in the same tab and verify the visible answer and notes before finalizing it.

scenes.narration: When review is complete, choose Submit checklist. The returned sheet shows Submitted, Score 100, and Close. Save progress and Submit checklist are no longer available. Here, one hundred is the result of the entered exercise answers. It does not establish physical equipment condition. For practice, identify the returned submitted state before treating the software run as finalized.

scenes.narration: This final sheet was reopened from refreshed History in the same tab. Submitted and Score 100 remain visible, along with the retained training notes. This browser exercise does not establish offline, browser-restart or device-location behavior.
